## GrantConstraint type

Represents the constraints on the use of a capability grant.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type GrantConstraint = {
    type: "unrestricted";
} | {
    type: "transferable";
    value: {
        secret: CapSecret;
    };
} | {
    type: "assigned";
    value: {
        secret: CapSecret;
        assignees: Array<AgentPubKey>;
    };
};
```
